Campbell Window Film — SEO Audit

Six specific fixes, with evidence and wider context in the full audit.

01

Commercial copy and Call Now need correction

The commercial tinting page names Dalo Glass Tinting and its Call Now link contains an extra “20” in the phone number.

  • Replace the unrelated brand and repair the joined sentence in the opening paragraph.
  • Change this Call Now target from tel:(800)20580-9997 to tel:+18005809997; preserve verified call tracking.
02

Security Film opens the wrong product

The homepage Security Film heading and Learn More button open Security Glass instead of the existing Security Window Film page.

  • On the homepage, point both Security Film links to /products/security-window-film/.
  • Keep the separate Security Glass card unchanged; edit these two links directly, without redirecting the valid glass page.
03

Mobile video and chat cause major shifts

The homepage Vimeo background transferred 10.64 MB and caused 0.429 of the mobile lab’s 0.585 layout shift, with HubSpot chat adding about 0.154.

  • Reserve the video container’s space and use a lighter static mobile background or defer the decorative video.
  • Keep the chat launcher stable and review greeting auto-expansion; retest shifts, first-screen rendering and contact functions.
04

Two comparison images download 2.83 MB

The below-fold homepage comparison eagerly loads new-before.png and new-after-1.png at about 1.42 MB each, without responsive sizes.

  • Create quality-preserving WebP/AVIF versions sized for the display, with responsive candidates and matching dimensions.
  • Lazy-load both below-fold images and verify that the comparison slider still works.
05

A valuable privacy page repeats its introduction

The one-way privacy page earned 202 Google clicks but repeats its opening paragraphs under the definition heading and has no links in its page body.

  • Replace the repeated block with a direct definition and clear day-versus-night privacy guidance, keeping the useful existing page.
  • Add relevant body links to Daytime Privacy Film, Frosted Window Film and Contact Us where the copy supports them.
06

Business schema contains empty template fields

Business markup on 116 checked pages leaves hours and offered-service details blank, with sampled templates using the relative identifier “LocalBusiness”.

  • Use a stable absolute business ID and verified Huntington Beach hours: Monday–Friday 8 AM–5 PM, weekends closed.
  • Remove or complete empty offer/service and unrelated template fields; keep accurate business details and the valid $$ price range.

Protect the traffic that already works

Two existing privacy/home-tint pages generate 46.6% of Google clicks, while Campbell’s analytics and qualified-lead mapping remain unverified.

  • Keep useful educational content and connect it to relevant services, coverage and quote paths.
  • Confirm Campbell’s own GA4 property and lead reporting before judging commercial impact or expanding content.

Fix order

Correct the customer journeys first, then improve mobile loading and the content that already attracts searches.

  • First: commercial copy/phone target, Security Film links, video/chat shifts and comparison images.
  • Next: privacy-page improvements, one schema cleanup and the measurement/local decisions in the full action plan.

Read-only findings; no website changes or tickets. Google lab results are not every visitor’s experience. Phone origin field LCP/CLS need improvement; field data is not homepage-specific. Full audit and action plan retain source dates, wider context and access gaps.
